{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"Snack your way past pickle stalls and quail eggs; the market hums loudest when you keep moving.","must_do_id":"m3"},{"poi_id":"p15","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Tofu done so gently it almost apologises; the set lunch is a quiet masterclass.","must_do_id":null},{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Slip down the lantern-lit side of Gion and let the old wooden facades do the talking.","must_do_id":null},{"poi_id":"p13","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Tiny bars, warm light, and the river close enough to hear; Pontocho after dark is pure Kyoto mischief.","must_do_id":null},{"poi_id":"p19","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A calm, plant-based dinner that even the street-food one will stop photographing long enough to eat.","must_do_id":null}]}
Lantern-lit first bites, gold and bamboo, then vermilion gates and old lanes — every must-do in, shoes off, phone down, eyes up.
